text.p: Lufthansa Technik (LHT), the maintenance subsidiary of Deutsche Lufthansa AG, said it has agreed a European maintenance joint venture with Bombardier Inc.

Under a statement of intent signed in Orlando, Florida, on Tuesday LHT and Bombardier Aviation Services will open a European services centre at Berlin Schoenefeld airport in mid-1997, a company statement said.
Lufthansa Technik will carry out their technical operations on the newly-developed Global Express business jet, Learjet and Canadair Challenger business aircraft, it added.

Bernhard Conrad, Berlin manager of Lufthansa Technik, said the new centre for European clients would generate up to 100 new jobs in the medium-term and was a boost for the Berlin Schonefeld air transport industry.
Bombardier vice-president and general manager, Jim Ziegeler, said Lufthansa Technik had won the deal through its know-how, excellent reputation and local capacity and staff.
Berlin Schonefeld was chosen for its central European location and unlimited 24-hour airport operations, he added.

Lufthansa Technik is one of the world's largest aircraft maintenance companies with an annual turnover of 2.5 billion marks, the company statement said. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
